newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India GDRs slide on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India GDRs slide on profit taking.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts lost ground on Thursday, as investors booked profits before a fourth of July slowdown, traders said.
"Shares followed the same pattern as the local market, spending most of day drifting with a little profit taking," a trader said.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.82 points lower at 89.76, down 0.82 percent, with the premium over the local market at 24.09 percent at 24.90 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index slid 8.78 points to 4,325.12.
Reliance fell 25 cents to $22.35/$22.85 and Telco lost six cents to $15.00/$15.75.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed 0.27 points higher, or 0.34 percent, at 78.74 points, a premium of 40.52 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 3.21 points higher at 128.33, representing a discount to the local market of 2.56 percent. - James Saft, London newsroom 44 171 542 2734
